shared_elements: carved stone surface in low relief
repeated small rounded motifs (bosses/discs in A, curl rows of hair and beads in B)
justification: Both are stone works whose surfaces carry shallow relief on a broadly human/anthropomorphic form, with incised horizontal banding and rows of small repeated rounded motifs, and each includes a curved object held or set at roughly waist height. But A is a single massive, weathered free-standing block with abstract, schematic motifs seen frontally, while B is a crisply cut, naturalistic frieze of several profile figures in procession, so composition and carving manner scarcely correspond.
